name: escalation-quality-v1
model_response_reuse: One Jev and one Codex answer per identical frozen packet; cascade reuses these actions.
continuation: Exact first-policy prefix; one intervention; fresh first-eligible continuation.
stop: Report incomplete on infrastructure/correctness failure. Never force positive routing. If calibration chooses never escalate, retain that result and evaluate the held-out negative outcome.
success: All outputs correct; held-out cascade gains over Jev exceed max(2%, observed paired noise), with consistent direction across both families, escalation <=25%, and no disadvantage beyond noise against nearest-neighbor. Stock improvement is a separate practical criterion.
maintenance: Frozen shift first; refit nearest-neighbor and recalibrate threshold using identical shift40 labels, evaluate both frozen/adapted on shift48. Count source/config/prompt changes, parameters/exemplars, labels and provider calls. No claim about human maintenance hours or long-term effort.
